description: This file defines the SensitiveDataMasker class, which provides methods to mask sensitive information in data structures based on pattern matching of keys and configurable masking parameters.

classes.name: SensitiveDataMasker
classes.description: A class for masking sensitive data in dictionaries, with configurable patterns, masking characters, and recursion depth.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SensitiveDataMasker with optional patterns, visible prefix/suffix lengths, and mask character.

methods.name: _mask_value
methods.description: Masks a string value by replacing the middle part with mask characters, preserving visible prefix and suffix.

methods.name: is_sensitive_key
methods.description: Determines if a given key matches sensitive patterns, considering exclusions.

methods.name: mask_dict
methods.description: Recursively masks sensitive data in a dictionary, respecting maximum depth and exclusions.
